graph_backbone.nodes: all 31110 descriptors in the sealed descriptor table

graph_backbone.edge_rule: include (u,v) exactly when c_uv * N > support_u * support_v
graph_backbone.arithmetic: non-negative integer products evaluated in at least 128 unsigned bits; equality is excluded

primary_formula.name: adamic_adar_q48
primary_formula.common_neighbor_set: the exact intersection of the sorted unweighted backbone neighbors of candidate endpoints u and v
primary_formula.per_neighbor_weight: floor(2^48 / Decimal(degree).ln()) after ln and division at precision 80
primary_formula.score: checked uint64 sum of per-neighbor weights; an empty intersection scores zero

common_neighbors.score: cardinality of the primary common-neighbor set

resource_allocation_q48.score: checked uint64 sum of per-neighbor weights

jaccard.ordering: exact descending rational comparison by cross multiplication

integer_baselines: the same splitmix64 tie key ascending
jaccard_baseline: the same splitmix64 tie key ascending
